name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Add season pack support: rank multi-episode and full-season releases correctly, resolve the right episode from a pack, and prefer a next-episode release from a similar pack when pre-downloading ahead. Add mid-stream release switching so a session can move to a better-matched release without dropping playback, with race-safe pre-download coordination and clearer failure reporting. Surface locally available and in-progress releases from Core to the Jellyfin plugin so search results reflect what's already downloading or ready. Consolidate the web dashboard's Ephemeral Files, Streaming History, and Stream Stats pages into a single tabbed Sessions view, and rename the Sessions nav item to Streams.
